title: Illness and her 1980 operation
summary: Feeling lousy, she kept going to hospitals until a nurse sent her to the right people. She had her operation on July 31, 1980 and was on her way to Japan a month later.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
